# PR-3 frozen legacy schemas

The eight `pr3_<revision>.sql` snapshots were generated by running the original
Alembic entrypoints from commit `739705c9f4bfbc7c9251027fc36e8f06ab94d8c5`
on empty disposable SQLite databases with Python 3.12. They are not generated
using the new unified graph. No live data is included.

- `0001` through `0004`: original `alembic/` entrypoint. The historical 0001
  imported the then-current ORM; the captured SQL freezes its actual schema,
  including already-present dedup columns/indexes. Future ORM changes cannot
  silently alter these fixtures.
- `70e6afc8d15d`, `5d4e3c2b1a0f`, `6a7b8c9d0e1f`: original `migrations/` entrypoint.
- `b2f3a4c5d6e7`: original migrations entrypoint, after adding the required
  runtime claim_relations table at 6a. The old chain cannot run B2 without it.
  Deliberately has no beliefs, evidence or FTS tables: it proves that a truly
  installed old B2 receives the missing additive schema at the new bridge.

The SQL contains schema plus the actual installed Alembic version. Tests load
it and insert deterministic application rows (including receipts, outbox and
belief/evidence references where supported), then invoke the official CLI.
Original columns/row values, FK metadata, FK/integrity results and FTS search
are checked after upgrade. Tests never stamp a fabricated schema to head.
